title: ドラゴンクエストVII エデンの戦士たち
title_romaji: Dragon Quest VII: Eden no Senshitachi
notes: The save menus and memory card messages are Shift-JIS, on disc and in RAM. The dialogue isn't: at the first conversation neither the line nor its はい/いいえ stands in RAM in a standard encoding, nor as 1- or 2-byte codes with one code per character (searched by the line's pattern of repeated characters, with and without codes for its spaces). Probably decoded a character at a time as it is drawn. Needs the game's own table and a way to follow the decoder.
sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 32,909, utf16le 8 characters of prose-like text
Headless replay from power-on to the first conversation: system messages found in RAM as Shift-JIS, the dialogue not
